limitations: Synthetic application usability only; no private user database, production recovery, client rebinding, reboot or whole-stack claim.
Exact snapshots created by the source job are frozen before destination execution; this does not retroactively qualify old private app-state archives.
Separate jobs and distinct boot identities support fresh-host separation; no independent administrative trust domain or account-loss recovery claim.
Sequential app snapshots are not one cross-application atomic transaction.
Selected source tests are distinct from the composed cross-host fixture and from actual destination acceptance.
Native applications run with owned paths and filtered environments on disposable runners; no general OS filesystem sandbox claim.
No token-saving claim; provider usage is not measured.

network_boundary.scope: Qdrant and unchanged upstream all-interface HTTP test helper share only the new loopback network.
